world.title: Right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round of Brazil election
world.description: With neither candidate getting more than 50% of the vote, the election will go to a run-off on 25 October.

world.title: Watch: How Brazil's dramatic election unfolded
world.description: Millions of Brazilians took to the polls on Sunday for the first round of the country's presidential elections.

world.title: US air force removes all bombers from British military base RAF Fairford
world.description: No reason has been given for the withdrawal, but it follows a major incident last week when police were alerted to "suspicious vehicles" near the airbase.

world.title: Trump unveils 'Super Intelligence Force' to oversee AI policy
world.description: The president named his national intelligence chief as the taskforce's head as worries over AI grow.

world.title: France closes up to 500 schools Monday over student protests
world.description: Lessons will be "totally or partly suspended" in some high schools after clashes between riot police and student protesters, France's education minister says.

world.title: All six passengers presumed dead after plane went missing off US coast
world.description: The aircraft lost communication with flight controllers after significantly dropping in altitude, according to flight data.

world.title: Supporters of jailed ex-PM Imran Khan march to Pakistan capital
world.description: Thousands have taken to the streets after talks between authorities and Khan's party ended in deadlock.

world.title: Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit
world.description: Footage shows a drone hitting the Pivnichyi (Northern) Bridge as vehicles move across it, creating a large fireball.

world.title: Forced to call him 'Dad': Trial over sexual abuse in disabled care home shocks South Korea
world.description: The BBC spoke to one of three residents at a care home who were sexually assaulted by a staff member.

world.title: Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis
world.description: The Yemeni president's announcement comes amid an exchange of strikes between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition.

world.title: Ethiopian rebel forces withdraw from Tigray regional capital
world.description: Two residents in Mekelle tell the BBC pro-government forces have taken control of the city.

world.title: Watch: What we know about Russian strikes on Kyiv bridges
world.description: BBC Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson is near Kyiv's Northern Bridge, which has been hit for the second day in a row.

world.title: Indian police accused of sexually harassing journalists at protest
world.description: The allegations were made after police detained dozens of protesters demanding the resignation of the election chief over changes to voter rolls.

world.title: Christa Pike's prognosis still unclear after failed execution, lawyer says
world.description: Pike's lawyer says doctors are still trying to clear two lethal doses of pentobarbital from her body.

world.title: Why Canada is wargaming a (long shot) US invasion
world.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney has said the military is running scenarios in the unlikely case the US invades Canada.

US.title: Spain's prime minister calls early elections as pressure mounts over housing crisis
US.description: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announced early elections Monday after his government suffered a bruising legislative defeat last week on emergency measures related to the country's housing

US.title: Super El Niño is here. What's so super about it?
US.description: This year, federal forecasters say the planet could see the strongest El Niño event on record. Here's what you need to know.

US.title: Republicans and Democrats find a unifying target: Pharmacy benefit managers
US.description: Republicans and Democrats, both patients and politicians, seem united in their disdain for the healthcare companies known as pharmacy benefit managers. Tennessee and Arkansas are regulating them now.

US.title: Voters are increasingly using AI chatbots to fact-check and compare candidates
US.description: Voters are already voting in the midterms. This year, some voters are trying something new to get ready for the election: asking AI to help research their ballot and even decide who to vote for.

US.title: Supreme Court's new term kicks off with blockbuster climate change case
US.description: The case centers on whether local governments can hold giant energy companies accountable for the local harms of climate change, but it has repercussions beyond climate.

US.title: From floating saunas to clinical trials: How heat might help mental health
US.description: While scientists have a decent understanding of how sauna and other forms of heat exposure exercises our cardiovascular system, they know relatively little about its impact on mental health.

US.title: Morning news brief
US.description: Investigators are still searching for the motive behind a midair attack aboard a FlyDubai plane, SCOTUS term begins with climate change case, Brazil's presidential race heads to run-off.

US.title: Brazil's presidential race heads to Lula–Bolsonaro run-off as right gains ground
US.description: Now there are two: Brazil heads into a runoff after a first round that failed to fully energize voters, setting the stage for a more polarized contest that Washington is watching very closely.

US.title: Brazil votes, with Lula facing Bolsonaro's son
US.description: In Brazil, President Lula da Silva faces Flávio Bolsonaro, son of the jailed former president, in a tight race.  If neither wins more than half the votes they'll face each other again on Oct. 25.

US.title: Trump names national intelligence chief Jay Clayton as new AI czar
US.description: Trump said Clayton will lead the White House's new "Super Intelligence Force," which will coordinate government engagement with artificial intelligence.
